citaat: These are the measures of success that we had for our previous AI marking assistant pilot: Marking Consistency: Agreement between AI and human marking within an acceptable threshold. Workload Reduction: Reduction in marking time without compromising quality. Feedback Quality and Timeliness: Faster turnaround while maintaining actionable feedback.
samenvatting: Succescriteria staan vast: consistentie, minder nakijktijd, snellere bruikbare feedback.

citaat: we can do all the set-up for the pilot now but cannot sign the contract until after official approval from our Digital Oversight Group (DOG) who meet on 27th January
samenvatting: Contract kan pas na goedkeuring Digital Oversight Group; die vergadert maandelijks.

citaat: Do you think Eduface could be used directly by students to provide formative feedback on their academic writing? We are looking for a tool to support this and it would be amazing if students could be using the same tool as staff.
samenvatting: Ze zoeken actief een tool voor formatieve schrijffeedback aan studenten zelf.

citaat: It would be helpful to gather some information from the lecturers now, before we meet, to understand their perspectives about using AI for assessment and feedback, so that we can do a 'before and after' evaluation.
samenvatting: Docentperceptie wordt formeel voor en na gemeten; acceptatie is een harde evaluatie-as.

citaat: The DPO sought and obtained assurances that Eduface will not use BSU student data for model training, cannot access other students' submissions, and does not hold a comparison repository. ... The DPO also required SCCs, the UK Addendum/IDTA, a TRA and contractual guarantees on transient processing.
samenvatting: DPO eist harde garanties: geen modeltraining, geen repository, SCC's/IDTA/TRA.

citaat: The programmes were selected on the basis of having a variety of subject areas and student numbers, together with module leaders who were confident in being involved in something new; they weren't selected because they had particular problems.
samenvatting: Pilotmodules zijn niet gekozen op pijn maar op spreiding en bereidwillige module leaders.

citaat: I would like to have their sign-off on the wording for the webinar messaging, given that the use of AI assistants for learning & teaching is a sensitive topic.
samenvatting: AI in beoordeling is intern politiek gevoelig; comms gaat langs DVC en hoofd comms.

citaat: I think Turnitin's response is disappointing. ... I suspect you must not be the only ones Turnitin sees as competitors. I'm thinking of Graide. As far as I know, there is no supported integration between Graide and Turnitin. Graide has gone for a different similarity/originality provider called Inspera Originality
samenvatting: Turnitin weigert API-toegang aan concurrenten; Graide loste dat op met Inspera.

citaat: One of the PGCE teams currently uses a shared QuickMark set in Turnitin to support consistency across multiple markers. They would like to know whether this set can be imported into Eduface.
samenvatting: Gedeelde QuickMark-set is hun bestaande consistentie-instrument tussen beoordelaars.

citaat: Module leaders for large cohorts with multiple markers are concerned that marking may initially take longer, some suggesting piloting Eduface with a sample of submissions only.
samenvatting: Angst dat nakijken eerst langer duurt is de grootste rem bij grote cohorten.

citaat: I'm seeking Kyriaki's advice on whether it's appropriate for us to be advocating for a particular tool at this stage (i.e. before the pilot has been able to inform our decision on implementation).
samenvatting: Ze willen niet als ambassadeur gezien worden zolang het besluit niet genomen is.

citaat: This questionnaire relates to the current DPIA which is for the pilot only. There will be different data implications for the full implementation.
samenvatting: Pilot-DPIA telt niet voor de uitrol; compliance-ronde komt opnieuw bij de licentie.

citaat: We are putting together a strategy for internal and external communications regarding our use and piloting of GenAI tools. ... we would like to postpone the first webinar and its publicity until after the first phase of internal conversations.
samenvatting: Externe communicatie wacht op interne draagvlakgesprekken over GenAI.

citaat: The DPIA has been approved. Please note comments from IT: "advice has been provided that this can proceed for the trial however, should we look to purchase and fully implement this service there will be some security considerations to follow up and ensure are clarified or mitigated before going live."
samenvatting: IT geeft groen licht voor de pilot maar houdt securitypunten open voor de uitrol.

citaat: Please note that these measures evaluate the success of the pilot and there is not necessarily a direct link to implementation i.e. success doesn't necessarily mean we will automatically implement a full licence (there may be other internal factors that influence the final decision).
samenvatting: Succes in de pilot garandeert geen licentie; er spelen andere interne factoren mee.

citaat: I've spoken to Helen, she sees the grading aspect as part of the pilot. Jeroen, could you set the system so that it will provide suggested marks (not just descriptor bands) for Jaya, please, and also make this feature available for all other participating modules
samenvatting: Ze willen expliciet voorgestelde cijfers, niet alleen niveaubanden.

citaat: The marks generated are broadly in line with what I would have awarded. However, one script received a score of 69. As a reminder, we do not provide marks ending in 9 ... I noticed that a few words are still appearing in American English ... I made minor edits to the language and phrasing of the feedback in a few places for clarity and tone.
samenvatting: Cijfers kloppen grofweg, maar huisregels en toon moeten handmatig bijgesteld worden.

citaat: I'm taking a very cautious approach as this was the group that had a very bad experience during the last year's pilot. I want to make sure Jaya is happy with it before the rest of the tutors start marking.
samenvatting: Deze docentgroep is gebrand door de vorige AI-pilot; vertrouwen moet eerst terug.

citaat: I asked her to follow advice and read the paper before she starts reading/reviewing Eduface suggested grade and feedback.
samenvatting: Vaste werkafspraak: eerst zelf lezen en oordelen, daarna pas de AI-suggestie.

citaat: Given that the AI feedback assistant is not actually the one marking the paper but only providing suggestions ... As a marker, it can be useful to see a 69, as it can flag that the paper/band is borderline, therefore requiring closer consideration by the tutor. The human marker should be the one taking this type of decisions rather than the AI.
samenvatting: Human-first is hun frame: AI signaleert grensgevallen, de docent beslist.

citaat: I noticed that the tone and language generated by the AI don't always align with how a person would naturally phrase things, but this wasn't an issue as I've edited them accordingly. I also adjusted some of the grades where they seemed either too high or too low, which is expected and highlights the importance of reviewing them carefully.
samenvatting: Toon en cijfers worden nog bijgesteld; dat wordt geaccepteerd, mits reviewen verplicht blijft.

citaat: We've recently received student concerns about the environmental impact of using Eduface for assessment. ... The UCU (academic staff union) in their newly published UCU Principles for Use of Artificial Intelligence suggests conducting an environmental impact assessment on any new AI tools.
samenvatting: Milieu-impact van AI is een echt bezwaar bij studenten en de vakbond UCU.

citaat: exploring the potential of Eduface as an additional approved tool in the University's toolbox to deliver an excellent student experience (i.e. through supporting consistent, high-quality, and timely feedback aligned with policy, data protection, and academic standards)
samenvatting: Hun eigen pitch: consistente, snelle feedback binnen beleid en academische standaarden.

citaat: please can we change the title of the webinar to "How Bath Spa University is Exploring AI-Assisted Assessment & Feedback in Higher Education". The word 'introducing' suggests that we will definitely be implementing it, which is not yet the case.
samenvatting: Ze bewaken scherp dat niets suggereert dat het besluit al gevallen is.

citaat: I'll share my experiences of the pilot (which have been positive so far) but I won't be specifically endorsing Eduface.
samenvatting: Champion deelt ervaringen maar geeft bewust geen aanbeveling af.

citaat: I will share the positive outcomes that have already arisen (e.g. conversations about rubrics, surfacing less-good practice).
samenvatting: Grootste vroege opbrengst: het gesprek over rubrics en zwakke beoordelingspraktijk.

citaat: I will also share the challenges, which are the same as for the other Jisc pilots, in terms of perceptions and conceptions of the use of AI tools in assessment.
samenvatting: De rem is sectorbreed hetzelfde: beeldvorming over AI in beoordelen, niet de techniek.

citaat: Many thanks for sending this through. We will include this, along with the outcomes of the pilot evaluation, to inform our decision about implementation.
samenvatting: Prijs gaat als input mee in het implementatiebesluit, niet als los onderhandelpunt.

citaat: We're planning on using eduface for the compulsory but formative lit review they submit ahead of full planning and implementation ... They submit the lit review, have a week asynchonours in groups to comment and feedback (peer), then John does (tutor), with this adding a third dimension.
samenvatting: AI-feedback wordt bewust als derde laag naast peer- en tutorfeedback gepositioneerd.

citaat: Students teach in schools and submit an essay and a portfolio of work (all in one document). The portfolio includes images of handwritten content. Would this be a limitation? The assessment is PASS/FAIL, students do not receive a percentage for their marks.
samenvatting: PGCE levert essay plus portfolio met handgeschreven beeld en pass/fail, geen percentages.

citaat: I am struggling to ensure generated feedback includes more of a focus on 'positives' or even neutral comments. I have tested adapting the tone and varied the instructions. Feedforward areas for development appear generally appropriate at the moment.
samenvatting: Feedback voelt te negatief; positieve punten krijgen ze er met instructies niet in.

citaat: The system didn't align with previous grading e.g. a secure pass was consistently marked as a fail on two rubric, but the comments generated are appropriate. I've reinforced with the team ... that marking is tutor led at all times, so the AI element should be edited to reflect the tutor assessment.
samenvatting: Cijfers wijken af van hun eigen norm; ze vangen dat op met 'tutor leidt altijd'.

citaat: Unfortunately, the marking isn't any more accurate - it's a little less so in fact, failing a previously securely passed assignment on 3 of the rubric. Despite the instruction not to use the second person 'you', the AI comments still do this ... tutors will just need to ensure they trust their own judgment rather than be influenced by the AI pass/fail
samenvatting: Na kalibratie werd het niet beter; risico op sturing van het docentoordeel wordt benoemd.

citaat: The inaccurate pass/fail isn't unexpected from my perspective. The PGCE is a professional rather than an academic programme and this is reflected in the assignment design
samenvatting: Beroepsopleidingen met portfolio passen slecht op academische beoordelingslogica.

citaat: Given PGCE tutors don't have dedicated marking periods - they are still supporting students, conducting QA visits to school placements etc - I can't deny this request.
samenvatting: PGCE-docenten hebben geen nakijkperiode; nakijken loopt door alles heen.

citaat: Wendy Geens would like to get started on marking and her account details came up with an error message so she emailed to say she would rather mark in TurnItIn.
samenvatting: Bij de eerste hobbel valt een beoordelaar direct terug op Turnitin.

citaat: I can mark all the other ones first (NP3-NP7) which will take me a few days with all the other things I've got on.
samenvatting: Nakijken schuift tussen al het andere werk door; dagen doorlooptijd per set.

citaat: My understanding is that it needs to be returned within 15 working days but the team will need to finish the marking earlier to allow for moderation and the upload of feedback to Ultra
samenvatting: Harde norm: 15 werkdagen terugkoppeling, inclusief moderatie en upload naar Ultra.

citaat: I'm finding the comment action hard to control and I cannot often access the button in the pop up. Can you advise? I cannot easily continue marking within edu-face if I cannot easily add comments!
samenvatting: UX-frictie bij in-tekst commentaar blokkeert het nakijken direct.

citaat: I do not think we can ethically avoid giving this student the same kind of feedback as the others. I can copy and edit the general Eduface feedback into Turnitin, where I can also give in-text comments as normal (my own).
samenvatting: Gelijke behandeling van studenten is een ethische ondergrens; anders val je terug op Turnitin.

citaat: Nick and I are just reviewing Eduface and looking at the initial comments its given for some of Ash's assignments. For AO11 we can see this ... Similarly with AO7 - it doesn't seem to know what it is reading from?
samenvatting: Programme director twijfelt of het model het werk uberhaupt goed inleest.

citaat: The style of feedback and grading of 7B and 7D is often failed and creates a dissonance with our current style and policy (eg 2nd person) which then feels either inaccurate or takes too much time to edit
samenvatting: Docent stapte uit de pilot: stijlbotsing met eigen beleid kost meer tijd dan het oplevert.

citaat: Quick mark comments are not logically listed and are in a small window so take too long to find what you want. It often isn't possible to select text from beginning and end of assignment so I am doing a less than complete marking job
samenvatting: Trage quickmarks en niet-selecteerbare tekst leiden tot half werk en afhakers.

citaat: My understanding is that the comments author is the lecturer only. ... There is a misalignment between this and what the students see when they open the file to view the comments: The author of the comments appears as "Lecturer + AI"
samenvatting: Wat de student ziet over AI-auteurschap moet exact kloppen met het beleid.

citaat: Just to confirm that I have been anonymising (redacting) submissions since 12:00 noon. I've done 11 and will be uploading these and all others after. Anonymising is a very slow process.
samenvatting: Zonder LMS-koppeling kost handmatig anonimiseren dagen werk van de projectleider.

citaat: The system was missing the mark in regards to feedback. I think due to the nature of the way the assessment is set up it was picking up on stuff that I felt wasn't relevant towards feedback ... So I opted to do the feedback my self and as that was done I released the marks.
samenvatting: Module leader haakte af zonder kalibratie: feedback raakte niet wat hij belangrijk vond.

citaat: Helen has come back to me to clarify that if adoption is approved by the DOG, the business case for will be written by us without involvement from Eduface, due to conflict of interest.
samenvatting: Wij mogen de business case niet schrijven; we kunnen alleen methodiek en cijfers aanleveren.

citaat: would it be possible to include an explanation of how the average time spent on marking is calculated and a definition of "accuracy" in this context, please? Is it possible, to include data showing Eduface's suggested grades alongside the final grades given by tutors?
samenvatting: Ze willen tijdswinst en accuratesse methodologisch onderbouwd, plus AI- naast docentcijfer.

citaat: Many thanks for suggesting the connection, it's sounds like interesting research. However, we don't have the capacity to be undertaking additional research projects at this time.
samenvatting: Geen ruimte voor extra projecten; alles wat tijd kost buiten de pilot wordt afgewezen.

citaat: Staff at Bath Spa are time-poor and under pressure, making steep learning curves a barrier to adoption. The university continuously adds new systems, creating additional burden on staff unless clear time benefits are demonstrated.
samenvatting: Elk nieuw systeem is extra last tenzij de tijdwinst meteen zichtbaar is.

citaat: The demo should include dashboards and metrics showing usage data to verify that staff actively engage with the tool rather than over-relying on AI feedback. Moderators should be able to see evidence of human interaction and decision-making in the marking process.
samenvatting: Adoptie-eis: aantoonbaar bewijs dat docenten niet blind op de AI leunen.

citaat: The demo must show the tool from multiple stakeholder perspectives: markers, moderators, module leaders, and external examiners. ... The workflow must support moderation processes where moderators can view staff submissions and module leaders can maintain oversight across multiple markers.
samenvatting: Zonder rolgebaseerde workflow voor moderatie en external examiners geen adoptie.

citaat: Retention policies are essential - the tool must retain all data for institutional appeals and external compliance with UK Office for Students requirements of five years post-graduation. Bath Spa retains materials for three additional years beyond the five-year requirement, totalling eight years
samenvatting: Acht jaar dataretentie is een harde eis vanuit OfS en hun eigen beroepsprocedure.

citaat: Susana noted that Turnitin has introduced a new Standard Assignment Tool with Blackboard integration, potentially eliminating friction by avoiding manual processes. ... staff currently perceive Turnitin as integrated with Blackboard Ultra due to its seamless functionality
samenvatting: Turnitin voelt voor docenten als onderdeel van Blackboard; dat is de lat voor ons.

citaat: We are progressing as planned with the write-up of the evaluation. I am on leave from tomorrow until 2nd September, and intend to discuss with Kyriaki soon on my return.
samenvatting: Evaluatie wordt intern uitgeschreven; DVC Kyriaki is de volgende halte.

citaat: as we enter the new academic and financial year, we are having to be very mindful of university budgets. This is likely to have an influence on whether or not we can take forward any new digital applications.
samenvatting: Budgetkrapte kan elke nieuwe digitale aanschaf blokkeren, los van pilotresultaat.

citaat: calculating the efficiencies of using Eduface (or any other digital tool) includes more than the time spent directly interacting with the tool. There are other activities around this that add to the overall time spent in assessment and feedback. Susanna has explored this through interviews with the module leaders
samenvatting: Zij rekenen het hele beoordelingsproces mee, niet alleen de tijd in de tool.

citaat: No BSU-approved AI tool for assessment/feedback exists yet; unmanaged AI use by staff risks academic standards, data protection, and policy/Student T&C violations.
samenvatting: De echte driver is governance: docenten gebruiken al AI, zonder goedgekeurde route.

citaat: Previously piloted KEATH.ai - did not meet their measures of success. Jisc is running a parallel pilot of three tools (KEATH, Graide, TeacherMatic) across several institutions.
samenvatting: KEATH viel af, Graide en TeacherMatic draaien parallel via Jisc als alternatief.

citaat: Pilot -> if successful, new concept paper to AIPB (AI Programme Board) and DOG (Digital Oversight Group) -> business case to UEB (University Executive Board) for full licensing decision. ... contract with Eduface will only be signed after (1) BSU's DPIA is signed off, and (2) formal approval from the Digital Oversight Group.
samenvatting: Drie gremia achter elkaar: AIPB, DOG, dan UEB; elke stap is een eigen cyclus.

citaat: I emailed my contact in e-Learning at Bath and they're not aware of any centralised interest in AI-assisted assessment and feedback.
samenvatting: Bij buurinstelling Bath is er geen centrale interesse; belangstelling komt van individuen.

citaat: I will start by explaining that Eduface operates on our own proprietary AI model, which we built ourselves, rather than relying on third-party foundation models. Next, I will detail how we trained this model specifically for higher education. This training involved using a database of academic papers and educational research to ensure didactic effectiveness
samenvatting: Onze pitch bij BSU: eigen model, getraind op academisch werk en onderwijsonderzoek.

citaat: It is certainly something we were considering when building our model. We specifically designed the model to be as small as possible to minimize its energy consumption.
samenvatting: Antwoord op het milieubezwaar: bewust klein model, lager energieverbruik.

citaat: Eduface is built in such a way that you as an educator can shape the form and also the quality of feedback that comes out. In order to show you what the tool can do, therefore, we need to have a list of criteria you check for
samenvatting: Wij framen het als: de docent bepaalt vorm en kwaliteit van de feedback, wij kalibreren.

citaat: In general, really large assignments is something AI struggles with. This is a known limitation we are working on for future versions of the product, but we are not able to 'force' the assignment through the tool at this stage.
samenvatting: Grote documenten zijn een erkende limiet die we open op tafel legden.
